evidence: Matches the TX fees and policy label and modifies package weight validation in policy.
rationale: Prevents potential integer overflow in package weight calculation as defense in depth. As the author notes, 'IsWellFormedPackage passed a plain 0, so the package weight was summed in an int... A package heavier than INT_MAX would wrap', though 'No package that large reaches this check today, since RPC request bodies are capped at 32 MiB and P2P messages at 4 MB'.
